name: Ha Long cu ky noodles
summary: Bún cù kỳ is the white-noodle bowl of cù kỳ, a small rock-crab-sized animal with big meaty claws. Báo Quảng Ninh, 13 Mar 2019, says the claw meat is seared with onion and garlic, the cracked claws go in the bowl, and the broth is the body. Shops add bề bề and shrimp.
origin: Hạ Long and Quảng Ninh. Chuyên trang du lịch Quảng Ninh names bún cù kỳ Hạ Long beside chả mực. Báo Quảng Ninh, 13 Mar 2019, says the bowl exists only in Quảng Ninh.
howToEat: The claw is the meat. It is seared with onion and garlic, then set on white noodles with the claws already cracked. The broth is cooked from the body after the meat is picked out.
Báo Quảng Ninh, 13 Mar 2019, says the bowl is sold in the morning with bún bề bề, and still at lunch in the eating areas and local markets at Bãi Cháy and Giếng Đồn.
That article printed 35,000–50,000 đồng a bowl. A current price is Check on arrival.
where: Bãi Cháy and Giếng Đồn, on the 13 Mar 2019 account. People catch cù kỳ from holes in the rock.
seoTitle: Bun cu ky Ha Long — claw meat on white noodles
seoDescription: Bún cù kỳ is claw meat seared with onion and garlic, on white noodles, in a broth from the body. The 2019 bowl was 35,000–50,000 đồng. A current price is Check on arrival.
taste: Báo Quảng Ninh, 13 Mar 2019, says the meat is sweet and does not taste like crab.
